registered: 2026-10-08, before the v2 re-score is computed (the 435 records exist; their v1 verdicts were reported earlier)
authority: battery packet v2 (#804, merged at fed634974f92575cbde509ddc83f5fc4a3fe28da, round1/battery-ev-fast-charge-v2.md); Test Lead relay. Local re-score of existing records only; no new solve
records: battery-feasibility-02 tier 1 (184), tier 2 (244) and refined (7) records on the operator host, summarised in summary.json

hard_criteria.charging_temperature: max volume-averaged temperature over every cc1, cc2 and cv leg of all 30 cycles <= 45 C
hard_criteria.plating: min plating overpotential over every charge leg >= 0 V

diagnostics: initial-rest, inter-leg rest (rest after CV), discharge and post-discharge rest temperature extrema, reported, never a hard rule; whole-programme maximum reported beside the charging maximum
objective: session-start 10-80 % time (charge-integral SOC clock incl. the 120 s rest), minimised; NOT_REACHED is UNRESOLVED for the objective
bands: a hard margin within 0.5 C (temperature) or 2 mV (plating) is REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED unless a refined solve settles it (rung change below the band and no sign change), as in the v1 summary
per_stratum: per ambient (5, 15, 25, 35, 40 C) and action: FEASIBLE, INFEASIBLE (with the failing hard criterion), REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED or COVERAGE_MISSING; the feasible set, best feasible time, unresolved count and discharge diagnostics

decision.question: one protocol + cooling action over the complete five-ambient mandatory panel
decision.admissible: FEASIBLE at all five ambients; any REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED or COVERAGE_MISSING ambient makes the action UNRESOLVED (tier-2 actions were solved at 25 and 35 C only)
decision.aggregation: #776 recommendation, HUMAN_INPUT in v2: worst of the 25 and 35 C session times
decision.pick: minimum aggregate time; the pick is UNRESOLVED if another admissible or unresolved action is within 0.5 min (the 30 s time-convergence demand) of it
decision.cooling: reported in two lanes: protocol-only (h x 1, the pinned reference cooling) and with the h-multiplier history actions (2, 4). v2 selects no cooling multiplier
